Approve all recommended and pending manual schedules for a warehouse within a date range.

Deprecated in favor of /bulk-approve, which also reports skipped
conflicts. This endpoint keeps its original response shape (approved
list only) but no longer approves schedules that conflict with an
approved Blocked schedule — those are silently skipped.
